sloka: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथावृत्तमनिन्दिते ।अभिभाषस्व मां देवि दूतो दाशरथेरहम् ।। ५.३५.७२।।।।
transliteration: etatte sarvamākhyātaṁ yathāvṛttamanindite ।abhibhāṣasva māṁ devi dūto dāśaratheraham ।। 5.35.72।।।।

translations.english: "O sinless lady I have given you a faithful account. I am a messenger of Dasaratha's son. And you may speak now, O divine lady
